brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants for a grandparent preparing their home for visits from a young grandchild. Make the practical benefit relevant to visits without promising worry-free visits, universal compatibility or easy installation. This is a hypothetical audience scenario, not customer research.

variants.concept: A kit for several parts of the home
variants.primary_text: Getting your home ready for a grandchild’s visit can mean noticing more than one spot: table edges, sockets, cupboards and doors. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit brings edge and corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet and fridge locks, and door guards together. Listed at ₹3,299; save ₹299 with prepaid payment. Adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit

variants.primary_text: Planning to fit guards and locks before a grandchild visits? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes edge and corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet and fridge locks, and door guards. 1-to-1 installation video support is available. Listed at ₹3,299; save ₹299 with prepaid payment. Adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: Get 1-to-1 Installation Video Support

variants.concept: Locks and guards for visit prep, with stated guarantees
variants.primary_text: Cupboards, the fridge and doors may be on your mind when a grandchild is coming over. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes cabinet and fridge locks and door guards, along with edge and corner protectors and socket guards. It has a 30-day money-back guarantee and a 720-day eligible-failure replacement guarantee. Listed at ₹3,299; save ₹299 with prepaid payment. Adult supervision is still needed.
variants.headline: Prepare for Visits with the 6-in-1 Kit
